name: Slider
description:
A value (or a range) on a track. The tone range glows in a recessed glass well; the
thumbs are glass beads. A glass value bubble appears while dragging or keyboard-focused.
Arrow keys step, Shift/Page keys take large steps, Home/End jump to the ends.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onValueCommitted, min, max, step, largeStep, format, unit, marks, thumbLabels, size, tone, bubble, disabled, name, id, onBlur, className, ...aria }: SliderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: bubble
props.description: auto: the value bubble shows while dragging or keyboard-focused. always: pinned.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the bubble and aria-valuetext. Default: the number plus `unit`.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The larger keyboard increment.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track; `true` puts one on every step (use for ≤ 20 steps).

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower allowed value.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when blur occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Fires once when the user lets go (or after a keyboard step).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment used by keyboard and stepper interaction.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Names each thumb of a range ("Minimum", "Maximum").

props.name: tone
props.description: The range colour. Status tones only when the value is a status threshold (R3.3).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the number, joined with a thin space ("Mbps", "%").

props.name: value
props.description: A number for one thumb, a pair for a range.
